author: Kushal
problem: Read N, M and P. Full moons happen on day M and then every P days after that. Print how many full-moon days fall in days 1 to N.
bug_description: Advances the next full moon by P * count instead of P, so the gap keeps growing.

comments.accurate: Counts the full-moon days from day 1 to day N, stepping P days between full moons
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts full-moon days up to day N, with the gap growing by P after each full moon
comments.wrong_location: Next-moon update verified; check that day N itself is included in the range
